item.title: Highland housing developments on track to add hundreds of units
item.description: Highland is making strides toward addressing its critical lack of housing. The hamlet’s development pipeline currently boasts multiple projects totaling over 200 potential units. If they all move forward as planned, it will amount to a roughly 8% increase in total housing supply. The most advanced project is Silver Gardens, a 57-unit affordable senior development […] The post Highland housing developments on track to add hundreds of units first appeared on Hudson Valley One.

item.title: Pay up or lose it
item.description: The Ulster County Economic Development Alliance (UCEDA) voted on Friday, February 27 to proceed with foreclosure on two parcels on the west side of Enterprise Drive at the onetime IBM Tech City complex in the Town of Ulster.
